title: Nahum
lead: Nahum of Elkosh is the prophet of the book of Nahum, a three-chapter oracle against Nineveh. Nothing else is known of him; Elkosh is an unknown place. The book falls between the sack of Thebes (about 663 BC) and the fall of Nineveh (612 BC).

sections.b: The name Nachum means "comfort." The heading calls him the Elkoshite and the book a "vision." Jerome (about AD 392) placed Elkosh in Galilee and says a guide showed him the village; others have placed it in Judah or at Alqosh in northern Iraq; the Lives of the Prophets puts it in Simeon. No view is certain.
